info.name: Arbiter — End-to-End: Case → Classification
info.description:
Exercises the real cross-module flow: POST a case to cases-service (multipart: `case` JSON part + optional `documents`), which persists it and calls classification-service (POST /api/v1/claims) to analyze it — forwarding claimedAmount and the documents as-is. Then GET the case to poll classification-service (GET /api/v1/claims/{id}) until a result shows up.

**Requirements**: both `cases-service` (port 8083) and `classification-service` (port 8082) up — `ClassificationServiceClient` runs in every profile (dev included), no special profile needed anymore.

**Document keys** (same convention as classification-service): `police_report`, `invoice`, `quote`, `item_photo` — or any free string, the Fast Track gate matches whatever `requiredDocumentTypes` the business rules ask for.

**`GET /api/v1/cases/{id}` is a pure read** — classification results are pulled in the background by `ClassificationRefreshScheduler` (every 5s by default). If the LLM is slow, GET may return `PENDING_CLASSIFICATION` — just call it again after a few seconds. Fast Track scenarios resolve instantly.

**Mock policies available** (from classification-service's MockInsurerAdapter):
- POL-001 (insuredId 12345678) — Asegurado de prueba, sum insured 500.000
- POL-CEL-2024-001 (insuredId 40.123.456) — Laura Fernández, sum insured 400.000, 0 prior claims
- POL-CEL-2025-099 (insuredId 30.555.777) — Marcelo Gómez, sum insured 1.200.000, 3 prior claims
- POL-CEL-2026-042 (insuredId 42.987.654) — Sofía Martínez, sum insured 1.300.000, 0 prior claims
- Cualquier otra póliza usa un fallback genérico (no explota).

**Scenario 5 — FALTA_DOCUMENTACION**: crea un caso de robo SIN adjuntar denuncia policial. Las reglas mock para 'Robo' requieren `police_report` + `item_photo`, así que la clasificación devuelve FALTA_DOCUMENTACION. Luego se suben los documentos faltantes vía POST /{id}/documents y se re-clasifica.
